notes: Refined story boundaries to eliminate overlap between API/UI and facade integration; tightened dependencies and evidence.

change_log.value: Split responsibility: backend API endpoints for set/get weights and trigger recomputation; frontend ChatWindow slider controls invoke API and render updated scores; persistence handled via S1 contract only (no duplication).
change_log.note: Remove overlap with facade integration and persistence logic
Ensure API/UI depends only on schema and core logic

change_log.value: Constrain to request/response contract only: accept optional weights payload, apply defaults when absent, and pass normalized weights to scoring engines; no UI or persistence logic.
change_log.note: De-duplicate concerns with S3 and S1
Facade requires schema for validation and engines for execution

change_log.value: Implement deterministic weighted aggregation with strict normalization (sum=1), clamping to bounds, and explicit handling of missing measures (zero-weight or redistribution per schema rules).
Unit tests for normalization, bounds, and missing-measure handling; integration tests validating API-triggered recomputation and facade propagation for both providers and trials.
